summary: Iteration 35 — Charades expansion (admin generate + Mistral packs), Grid Themes IA rotation (10 families), Mots Fléchés MVP (5 hand-authored grids + interactive frontend). Backend 13/13 pytest passes. Frontend: /app/mots-fleches renders 5 grid cards, GridPlay shows 5×5=25 cells (9 blocks + 16 letters), typing auto-advances to next letter cell, Backspace on empty moves left, arrows navigate, correct submit awards 21 pts (16 letters + 5 bonus), reset clears result and disables submit. PlatformSection card 'mots-croises' is Live with live badge, Navbar has nav-mots-fleches link.

issues: Navbar is very cramped: 'Quiz du Jour ✨' wraps to 3 lines, and Ligues/Niv 20/Défi famille/Crédits crowd the right. Consider consolidating the games menu into a dropdown, or hiding secondary items on <1280px.

action_items: (nice-to-have) De-clutter the desktop navbar — the growing list of game links wraps awkwardly. Consider a 'Jeux' dropdown grouping Charades / Mots Mêlés / Mots Fléchés / Atelier.
critical_code_review_comments: wordsearch_mistral.THEME_FAMILIES: all 10 required families present, PROMPT_TEMPLATE correctly interpolates {family}/{hint} and picks a random family per generation call — good.

charades.py /admin/generate: correctly gated behind get_admin_user (403 for non-admin verified), idempotent on duplicate answers (rejected_reasons captures 'duplicate answer'), and merges Mistral extension via _all_charades().
mots_fleches_data._public_grid: correctly strips 'answer' from letter cells and preserves clue_h/clue_v on blocks — anti-cheat OK.
mots_fleches submit: xp_total credited only on delta (points - best_prior), so re-submitting a max score correctly yields points_gained=0 — verified.
MotsFleches.jsx GridPlay uses letters state shape derived from grid.cells (map row → map c to ''), consistent 5×5 payload sent to backend.
Auto-advance on typing uses setTimeout(...,0) which works but relies on the onChange also firing setLetter. Fine but note that fast typing could theoretically race — not observed in testing.
test_credentials: admin@generaquiz.fr / Admin2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md); dynamic TEST_iter35_*@example.com users registered per test session
seed_data_creation: Test users registered via /api/auth/register with TEST_ prefix; two admin/generate calls added Mistral charades to mistral_charades collection (real Mistral live call, ~10s each).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL must be exported: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://caricature-saas.preview.emergentagent.com when running pytest. Admin generate is idempotent — re-runs return accepted=0 if duplicates. Mots Fléchés mf01 correct matrix confirmed: 16 letter cells, score = 16 + 5 completion bonus = 21.
